component.name: Slider
component.description: Range slider component with single or multi-thumb support and step markers.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Slider container that owns track, range, thumbs, and labels.

slots.name: track
slots.description: Background rail representing the full slider range.

slots.name: range
slots.description: Filled segment between the start of the range and active thumb values.

slots.name: divider
slots.description: Visual marker for one slider step.

slots.name: thumb
slots.description: Draggable handle for one slider value.

own.name: allowThumbCrossing
own.description: Whether dragging can continue across another thumb when there is no minimum gap.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root element.

own.name: defaultValue
own.description: The default value of the input (uncontrolled).

own.name: divider
own.description: Whether to show visual step dividers on the track, only applicable when `step` is defined and greater than 0.

own.name: id
own.description: The ID of the input element.

own.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
own.description: Minimum steps required between thumbs in a multi-thumb slider.

own.name: name
own.description: The name of the input element, used for form submission.

own.name: onChange
own.description: Callback when the slider selection change is committed.

own.name: onValueChange
own.description: Callback when the slider selection changes during interaction.

own.name: step
own.description:
Step increment between values.
When omitted, pointer movement is continuous.

own.name: value
own.description: The current value of the input (controlled).

aria.description: Provides an accessible label when visible text is not sufficient.

aria.name: aria-readonly
aria.description: Indicates that the control value cannot be changed by the user.

aria.name: aria-required
aria.description: Indicates that user input is required.

aria.name: aria-valuemax
aria.description: Defines the maximum value for range-like controls.

aria.name: aria-valuemin
aria.description: Defines the minimum value for range-like controls.

aria.name: aria-valuenow
aria.description: Defines the current numeric value for range-like controls.

aria.name: aria-valuetext
aria.description: Provides human-readable text for the current value.

aria.name: role
aria.description: Defines the semantic role exposed to assistive technology.
